mapper.sql: a.dcr20_relate_ics_id AS relate_ics_id, a.dcr20_dcr_class_tree_id AS dcr_class_tree_id, a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id AS ics_class_tree_id, f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name, b.ics01_content AS content, b.ics01_submit_to AS submit_to, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) ELSE MAX(f_cdnm('CycleCode', sch03_cycle_cd, sch03_company_id, f_sysdate())) || ' 외 ' || COUNT(sch03_deadline.*) - 1 || '건' END FROM sch03_deadline WHERE sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') AND b.ics01_class_tree_id = sch03_info_id AND b.ics01_company_id = sch03_company_id LIMIT 1 ) AS cycle_name, b.ics01_related_law AS related_law, b.ics01_class_tree_cd AS class_tree_code, a.dcr20_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dcr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr20_dcr_class_tree_id = #{dcrClassTreeId} ORDER BY a.dcr20_relate_ics_id
SELECT FROM dcr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id WHERE a.dcr20_relate_ics_id = #{relateIcsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dcr20_relate_ics (dcr20_relate_ics_id, dcr20_dcr_class_tree_id, dcr20_ics_class_tree_id, dcr20_company_id, dcr20_note) VALUES (#{relateIcsId}, #{dcrClassTreeId}, #{icsClassTreeId}, #{companyId}, #{note})
